newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation quickens to 1.1 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation quickens to 1.1 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated to have accelerated in the week ended January 6 to 1.1 percent from 0.4 percent in the week ended December 30, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
The committee said it was no longer formally collating weekly inflation data, but would publish estimates of the weekly trend.
Russian inflation often accelerates in January as the government raises prices under its control.
